mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a beautiful 70 degrees out by Badger Ridge Middle School. Tonight, you can catch the International Space Station crossing the sky for five minutes starting at 5:46 PM, rising over Mount Horeb and moving toward the northeast near the Home Depot.

In city updates, the Verona Police Department has released a summary of calls from the first half of November. Additionally, the city is inviting residents to a public meeting on December 8 at the Senior Center to discuss the paving and bridge replacement project for the Military Ridge State Trail.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Today, you can catch trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.

Looking at the recent police activity, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot led to an arrest for O W I involving a driver who had a passenger under 16 years old in the vehicle.
It is a great day to grab a scoop of the Caramel Turtle flavor of the day. The shop is currently open, so make sure to stop by before they close at 10 PM.
